case.summary: Customer C07297 reported unauthorized activity on card C07297-K1 after flagging transaction 3476682 for $482.12. Investigation identified an episode of 4 online purchases for product C occurring between 2016-11-21 20:00:00 and 2016-11-21 20:30:00, totaling $1,906.07 across regions 264 and 476. The activity represents structuring, with each transaction kept between $400 and $500 to stay beneath a $500 authorization threshold. With a calibrated fraud probability of 0.92 from a new device profile D000061, the case was confirmed as fraud, card C07297-K1 was blocked, and a SAR was initiated under case HHG-006.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report involves customer C07297 and credit card account C07297-K1. Customer C07297 initiated a fraud dispute regarding an unrecognized online transaction 3476682 in the amount of $482.12. A subsequent review revealed an episode of 4 online transactions conducted on 2016-11-21 between 20:00:00 and 20:30:00. The transactions were executed online for product C across region 264 and region 476. Specifically, transactions 3476602 ($478.95), 3476633 ($456.96), 3476665 ($488.04), and 3476682 ($482.12) resulted in a total exposure of $1,906.07. The activity reflects structuring behavior, as all 4 purchases were kept between $400 and $500 within a 30-minute window to avoid a $500 control threshold. The flagged transactions significantly deviated from the card baseline of 101 prior transactions averaging $115.15 (z=2.5). Furthermore, the transactions originated from device profile D000061 (Trident/7.0 | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1080), which was marked as new for this account. Supervised graph feature modeling calculated a calibrated fraud probability of 0.92, supported by case memory where 4 of 5 similar closed cases were confirmed fraud. Under policy rule R9, a SAR is filed because the total exposure of $1,906.07 exceeds $1,000 under an undocumented pattern.
